title: Summer Fits That Actually Look Good and Keep You Cool
description: Dress for 25-35°C heat without looking like you gave up. Five outfit combos that survive real summer without sweat stains.
excerpt: Winter is easy — layers hide everything. Summer catches every mistake. And every sweat patch.
content:
Once it hits 32°C, your regular wardrobe stops working. Layering is out, dark colors kill you, and fabric decides whether you survive the day or drown in your own sweat.

## Fabric first, cut second

100% cotton is the baseline — but not paper-thin, because it shows through. Look for 180-220 gsm on the label. Linen rules at 35°C+ but wrinkles instantly. Merino in summer? Seriously yes — it regulates temperature, doesn't stink, dries fast. Avoid polyester blends unless you enjoy swimming in your own moisture.

## 5 combos that work

1. **Wide linen trousers + basic white tee + sneakers** — 90s vibe, foolproof. Add a colored belt or bucket hat for personality.
2. **Above-knee shorts (7-9 inch) + polo + sliders** — polo reads grown-up without long sleeves.
3. **Cargo shorts + oversized tee + tech sneakers** — still-running 2024 look. Not too oversized or you look sloppy.
4. **Light denim shorts + linen shirt open + espadrilles** — Italian summer, works at the beach or coffee shop.
5. **Light track pants + tank + retro sneakers** — weekend energy. Track pants must be thin, not fleece.

## Colors that actually work

Ditch grey — light grey heats up just like dark. Best bets: off-white, sand, sage green, faded blue. Skip saturated colors (cobalt, fire red) — they look cheap under strong sun.
